name: JK Imouto.
source: The protagonist, Tonomiya Masashi, wakes up one morning and realizes that he has completely lost his memories. He doesn't even recognize his own name. As he explores an unfamiliar house, he learns that he has three younger sisters, and they all live together in the house while their parents are currently traveling overseas. The story revolves around Masashi struggling with his newfound situation of living under the same roof with three unknown high school girls, as well as dealing with the sibling relationships. Will he be able to keep his cool around them? Will his memory ever come back? Only time will tell.
translation: 主人公远宫正史一天早上醒来，发现自己完全失去了记忆。他甚至不认识自己的名字。当他探索一栋陌生的房子时，他得知自己有三个妹妹，她们都住在房子里，而她们的父母目前正在海外旅行。故事围绕正志与三名身份不明的女高中生住在同一屋檐下的新处境进行斗争，并处理兄弟姐妹的关系。他能在他们面前保持冷静吗？他的记忆还会恢复吗？只有时间才能证明一切。
